reason: Check that item, library, and doctor changes stay inside zot-cli ownership.
Verify clap, JSON contract, and workspace test gates for the new routes.
Verify busy, 404, identity, disabled API, and file errors do not cross sources.
Verify commands do not open SQLite when the desktop route is the selected source.
Verify the connector remains import-only and doctor capabilities stay separate.
Verify ordinary reads do not call authorize or change the local write contract.
Verify one-source routing, incomplete scans, version consistency, and citation-key candidates.
Verify human and JSON output redact secrets and do not dump PDF text in diagnostics.
Verify snapshot consistency and the read-only source database constraint.
Verify SQLite, IO, and Pdfium errors keep their existing codes.
Verify search pagination, field filters, and citation-key exactness.
Verify any new error code is a real envelope code with a stable hint.
Verify BBT is limited to item.search and cannot be pointed at an unproven library.
Verify plugin-unavailable is distinct from not-found and identity mismatch.
Verify one command uses one source and one library identity end to end.
